description.text:
The first expansion of the Pokémon Card Game MEGA series, made to go with the game Pokémon Legends: Z-A and released on 1 August 2025 together with Mega Symphonia. Mega Lucario ex leads it, a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex that can do great damage from early in a game, and every Pokémon ex in the pair is a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. Mega Venusaur ex, with very high HP and an attack that heals itself, Mega Absol ex, whose attack can knock out the opponent's Active Pokémon in one hit when its conditions are met, Mega Mawile ex, which grows stronger the more Prize cards its player has taken, and Mega Camerupt ex join it, with the Supporters Lillie's Determination, which shuffles its player's hand into the deck and draws up to eight cards, and Lt. Surge's Bargain. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 63, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Trainer cards, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Lucario ex as a Mega Ultra Rare. In English most of its cards came out in the Mega Evolution expansion in September 2025, together with Mega Symphonia's.

Mega Brave and Mega Symphonia opened the series that brought back Mega Evolution, as Mega Evolution Pokémon ex: special Pokémon with high HP and strong attacks or Abilities, some of them Basic Pokémon and some Evolution Pokémon, which give the opponent three Prize cards when knocked out. The card frame stayed as it was in Scarlet & Violet. From this series the Super Rare cards take in Items, Pokémon Tools and Stadiums as well as Pokémon ex and Supporters, such as Night Stretcher here and Rare Candy in Mega Symphonia, and the Mega Ultra Rare (MUR), gilded over the whole card, took over from the Ultra Rare and the Black White Rare. The pair's Art Rare and Special Art Rare cards have illustrations that join up when laid side by side.
